figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: For skilled freelancing the signals are small. AmbitionBox shows an average starting pay of about Rs 10,000 a month (page updated 28 December 2024), and Upwork says beginners typically charge about $10 to $25 an hour. Lakhs a month is a real outcome for some people, but it is the strong end of the range, not the middle.

blocks.heading: Moves a Skill From Thousands to Lakhs

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: ₹1 lakh a month needs about 100 billable hours (hours a client pays for) at ₹1,000 an hour, about 50 at ₹2,000 and about 34 at ₹3,000.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: On one India rate list, experienced web, app, UX and SEO work pays ₹2,500 to ₹4,000 or more an hour, so ₹1 lakh needs about 25 to 40 hours of paid client work.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 2 lakh learning budget, a tenth is Rs 20,000 for the main course and a fifth is Rs 40,000. Spend the rest on a laptop, internet, tools, practice projects and a reserve for slow months. Before paying, check the instructor's recent client work, the last update, graded projects and what past learners actually got.
